A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Mocap-2-to-3, and all ten pages of each are readable, including equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original RICH and AIST++ evaluations in Tables 1–2, ablation results in Table 3, and qualitative reconstructions in Figure 4.

after.justification: v3 retains the original quantitative evaluations, ablations, and qualitative reconstructions reported in Tables 1–3 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same two-stage diffusion training, local/global motion decomposition, ground-pointmap conditioning, iterative triangulation and reprojection, and SMPLify fitting. The revised explanations and notation do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Training retains HumanML3D, BEDLAM, Human3.6M, and the RICH 2D-data variant. Evaluation retains RICH with ground-truth SMPL keypoints and AIST++ with ViTPose COCO keypoints; no dataset, task, or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SMPLify, MotionBERT, SA-HMR, WHAM, GV-HMR, and GV-HMR+SMPLify. Table 2 retains ElePose, MAS, SMPLify, MotionBERT, WHAM, GV-HMR, and MVLift. The added related-work discussion introduces no evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: The architecture size, four-view configuration, learning rates, batch sizes, training epochs, and sequence length in Section 4.1 are unchanged. Sections 4.2–4.4 retain the same metrics, alignment procedures, ground-truth versus detector inputs, and dataset-use restrictions.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 and Table 3 retain the same pointmap-removal and additional-RICH-2D-data ablations. Figure 4 preserves the same qualitative comparisons; no robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is added.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The reporting practice remains point estimates without quantified uncertainty.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–3 are identical. For example, RICH PA-MPJPE/MPJPE/Abs-MPJPE remain 25.8/38.7/152.5, and AIST++ PA-MPJPE/MPJPE/Troot remain 60.5/92.4/64.7. Figure 4 and the reported qualitative findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The ground-plane equation and local-to-global transformation retain their mathematical content. v3 changes coordinate symbols, relocates tensor dimensions, and explicitly writes the concatenation already described in v1 Section 3.1. These are notation and exposition changes, without new derivations, assumptions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The claims about using 2D pretraining to improve 3D motion recovery, recovering absolute positions, and outperforming prior methods remain. The revised second contribution explicitly mentions ground-contact constraints, but ground-based geometric conditioning was already claimed in v1's abstract and method.

C2.justification: The interpretations of pointmap benefits, generalization, and supplementary 2D training remain unchanged. Section 4.6 retains the same limitations concerning 2D skeleton accuracy, manual annotation costs, and fixed-camera applicability.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, data preparation, camera-calibration requirements, and promise of future public code release are retained. The rewritten implementation paragraph and tensor notation disclose no additional reproducibility resource or substantive technical setting.

R1.justification: New Section 2.3 discusses motion generation through MDM, MAS, and Motion-2-to-3, all already cited in v1. Section 2.2 compresses the MVLift comparison and removes the explicit architectural-similarity statement. This modestly revises positioning while retaining the same 39 referenced works.

P1.justification: v3 adds the motion-generation subsection, condenses several related-work, method, and implementation passages, adds method-section cross-references, and revises terminology and notation. Most prose and the overall document organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 moves from page 6 to page 7, Figures 1–2 receive caption edits, and Equation (2) is reformatted. The four figures and three tables retain their underlying visual content and structure.

improvement.justification: The dedicated motion-generation discussion, clearer method overview with section pointers, and cleaner presentation of Equation (2) modestly improve readability and context. The polish is uneven: v3 drops the explicit MVLift architectural-similarity statement and introduces a coordinate-subscript typo in Section 3.3.1. With experiments, conclusions, and reproducibility information unchanged, the overall benefit is limited.
